value.deck: A report finds that leading frontier AI labs have not publicly disclosed concrete containment strategies for the scenario where an AI model behaves outside its intended parameters.
shortVersion: A report finds that leading frontier AI labs have not publicly disclosed concrete containment strategies for the scenario where an AI model behaves outside its intended parameters.
The lack of transparent safety plans from frontier labs raises governance and liability questions that enterprise developers integrating AI into critical systems need to account for.
